title: A look at deployment: Docker Swarm, Nomad, Kubernetes and PaaS

videos.script: Compose runs an application on one machine. When the machine goes, the application goes with it. {{swarm}} An orchestrator is told what should exist, and keeps making it true. Docker has one built in, called Swarm. Ana asks for three copies of shelf, kills one, and watches it come back on its own. {{update}} Then a new version, rolled out one copy at a time, and rolled back with one command. {{landscape}} And last, the wider choice: Swarm, Nomad, Kubernetes, or a platform that just runs the image. Whichever it is, the image is the same.
